about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Turkey''s diecast model car marketplace
about.story: Tarodan was founded to provide a secure marketplace for collectors and sellers. We bring buyers and sellers together.
about.mission: Our mission is to offer the best shopping and trading experience for model car enthusiasts.
about.values: Our values: reliability, transparency, and respect for collector culture.

shipping.title: Shipping & Delivery
shipping.subtitle: Delivery times and shipping information
shipping.methodsDesc: Your orders are shipped with our partner carriers. The seller ships the item after payment.
shipping.costsDesc: Free shipping on orders of 500 TL and above. Standard shipping fee applies below that.
shipping.timesDesc: Domestic deliveries are usually completed within 2–5 business days. Times may vary by carrier and region.
shipping.trackingDesc: You can track your order from the "My Orders" page or via the tracking link in your email.

paymentOptions.title: Payment Options
paymentOptions.subtitle: Accepted payment methods and security
paymentOptions.acceptedDesc: You can pay securely with credit card, debit card, or virtual card. Payments are processed via PayTR.
paymentOptions.securityDesc: Your card details are encrypted with 256-bit SSL. We do not store your full card number on our payment page.
paymentOptions.installmentsDesc: Installment options are shown at checkout according to bank promotions.

returns.title: Returns & Exchanges
returns.subtitle: Return policy and process
returns.policyDesc: You have the right to withdraw within 14 days of receiving the product. The product must be in original packaging and unused.
returns.processDesc: You can start a return request via support or the order detail page. After approval, shipping details are shared.
returns.timelineDesc: After we receive the return shipment, the review is completed within 5 business days. Refunds for approved returns are processed within 14 days.

security.title: Security & Privacy
security.subtitle: Buyer protection, payment security, and data privacy
security.measuresDesc: The site is encrypted with TLS/SSL. Payments are processed via PCI-DSS compliant infrastructure.
security.buyerProtectionDesc: Payment is held securely until the buyer receives the item. Refund and dispute resolution processes apply when issues arise.
security.dataPrivacyDesc: Your personal data is processed in line with our Privacy Policy and applicable law. Payment details are stored by the payment provider.

sizeGuide.title: Size Guide
sizeGuide.subtitle: Model car scales and size comparison
sizeGuide.intro: Diecast models are described by scale—the ratio of the model to the real vehicle.

authenticity.subtitle: Verification process and counterfeit protection
authenticity.processDesc: Sellers and listings are reviewed for compliance with platform rules. Reported content is investigated.
authenticity.protectionDesc: Listings for non-authentic or misleading products are prohibited. Violations may result in listing removal and account measures.
authenticity.badgesDesc: Verified seller and approved listing badges are used to indicate trusted parties.

collectorsGuide.title: Collector''s Guide
collectorsGuide.subtitle: Collecting tips, storage, and valuation
collectorsGuide.tipsDesc: Keeping items in original packaging helps preserve value. Store away from moisture and direct sunlight in a dust-free environment.
collectorsGuide.gradingDesc: Condition terms used in the market (mint, excellent, good, etc.) are stated in listing descriptions. Communication between buyer and seller is important.
collectorsGuide.storageDesc: Use display cases or closed shelves; avoid prolonged direct light. Prefer low-humidity environments.
collectorsGuide.valuationDesc: Prices are set by sellers. You can get an idea of market value by searching for similar listings.
